title: Build the TechBridge Homepage
description: Create the first version of the TechBridge website using HTML and CSS.
detail: The foundation everything else sits on — hero, about, programs teaser, internship section, community and contact, hand-built and responsive from the first line of CSS.

title: Build the TechBridge Programs Experience
description: Create a Programs experience presenting TechBridge's available learning programs.
detail: A dedicated page breaking down both learning tracks — Data Analytics and Web Development — with the skills each one builds and a clear next step into the internship.

title: Build the Internship Tasks Experience
description: Create an interface that presents the TechBridge internship tasks and helps users understand the internship journey.
detail: A day-by-day timeline of all 8 tasks, showing what is done, what is being worked on and what is still ahead — readable without any JavaScript at all.

title: Build an Interactive Internship Roadmap
description: Use JavaScript to allow visitors to switch between the Data Analytics and Web Development internship tracks.
detail: The first JavaScript on the site — a track switcher that swaps the entire 8-task journey between the two tracks without a page reload.

title: Build the TechBridge Challenge Hub
description: Create an interactive Challenge Hub where visitors can browse, filter and open practical challenges from both tracks.
detail: Eight realistic briefs across both tracks, filterable by track and difficulty, searchable by keyword, each opening into a full specification in a modal.

title: Build the Interactive Intern Dashboard
description: Create a dashboard where an intern can track progress across all 8 tasks, filter them, and explore modern web technologies.
detail: A live progress bar that recalculates as tasks are completed, a task tracker generated from data, a link through to the Challenge Hub, and an interactive technology explorer.

title: Backend API Integration
description: Convert the dashboard's static task data into API-driven data using a Node.js + Express REST API.
detail: The dashboard now talks to a real backend — a Node.js + Express REST API backed by a JSON data file, connected over fetch(), with loading, error and offline states.

title: Build the Complete TechBridge Internship Platform
description: Combine the different components created during the internship into a complete TechBridge platform.
detail: Every piece built across the internship — homepage, programs, tasks, roadmap, challenges, dashboard, API — merged into one platform that actually holds together.
